scopeNote: Zero real vendor/model/native turns. Only B-owned paths. No second ledger/coordinator/lifecycle, no frozen-wire edit, no main guard removed, no global socket scan, no unrelated credentials. Twelve services and all ledgers untouched. Two historical report diffs and untracked b16-real-begin.mjs preserved.

notWrapperOnly.statement: the business channel source is real and is not called wrapper-only
notWrapperOnly.preserved: old control 9/9 (registration/guard/pending/post-proof 5, identity/inode/epoch 3 plus control branch), reconcile 4/4, actual-module strict/exactOptional clean, normal producer Q&A + physical stop 10/10

factsNotIdentityBound.before: a facts page carried no producer identity, so a caller could not tell whose page it was
factsNotIdentityBound.after: the server injects its OWN registered producer into every page, and the client verifies that producer against its trusted producer BEFORE returning any frame
factsNotIdentityBound.honesty: an earlier draft wrote a placeholder verification that did nothing; it was replaced with a real match that throws identity_mismatch

noBoundedPagingOver64KB.before: a legal 160-entry journal exceeded the single response and could not be replayed
noBoundedPagingOver64KB.after: GET /v1/facts now takes an explicit maxBytes page budget (1024..1048576, invalid budgets refused), pages are closed by bytes, the page-end cursor is the journal's REAL immutable seq rather than a renumbered array index, and done states the end
noBoundedPagingOver64KB.largeFrame: a single frame larger than the budget still gets its own page instead of being dropped, so a valid large payload is readable deliberately rather than silently truncated

lowLevelCommandMutatedBeforeIdentityRefu.before: the route compared a producer spread over the command against itself, so source and identity always matched and a foreign producer could still reach the backend
lowLevelCommandMutatedBeforeIdentityRefu.after: the command request must now state its producer envelope; the server validates that envelope and that the command's own ticket/epoch match the claimed attempt BEFORE dispatching to the backend

deliveredSource.typecheck: root tsconfig reports no error in any of the four files

covers: multi-page complete replay with contiguous original seq
foreign command refused 409 before backend write
acceptanceHarness.observed: the real FileCriticalJournal refuses my synthetic entries with journal_snapshot_unverified, because whole-file verification requires real payload/reference consistency that hand-written facts do not satisfy
acceptanceHarness.meaning: the code paths are implemented and type-clean, but the bounded-replay and pre-write-refusal claims are NOT yet observed. The harness must build its journal through the real payload/driver path instead of fabricating entries.

stillNotDone.B1_rfcAndMinimalInterfaceForMain: no RFC document yet; the four methods are the intended surface but are undocumented for main
stillNotDone.B2_fullAcceptance: identity/foreign/old-epoch/replaced-socket cases not independently asserted in a passing harness
stillNotDone.B3_unifiedDispatch: the new endpoint command path and the original stdio path are not yet proven to share ONE dispatch with begin-once/prepared-policy/control-priority
stillNotDone.B4_realRebind: fact sink receipt ACK, immutable payload read response and native write admission are still bound to the original stdio channel; they are NOT yet rebindable to a new client

limitations: the acceptance harness does not pass, so none of the B2/B3 behaviours is claimed as observed
no installed agent or gateway was contacted; the lane is a local journal plus the real authenticated endpoint
receipt ACK, payload reads and native write admission remain on the original stdio channel
one of three runnable milestones published
